name: Felt Handheld Flag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from soft felt fabric, offering a lightweight, flexible, and comfortable feel.
    - The felt material provides a soft texture while still holding the flag shape nicely for display and handheld use.
    - Designed with a quality wooden stick for a sturdy grip and easy handling.
    - Finished with a plastic tip at the top of the stick to improve safety and help secure the flag neatly in place.
    - Suitable for vibrant custom printing on both sides.
    - Ideal for events, celebrations, school activities, photo props, cheering accessories, and personalized gifts.
    - Available flag shapes: Triangle, Rectangle.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 27.94 x 15.24 cm ~ 11 x 6 in
    - Total height with stick: 31.5 cm ~ 12.4 in
    📌 Note: Please allow about 1 cm difference due to manual measurement.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Support double-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a decorative handheld flag and a personalized event accessory.
    - Suitable for birthdays, first day of school, classroom celebrations, holiday events, parties, cheer activities, themed photo shoots, and school performances.
    - Easy to carry, wave, display, and use as a fun prop.
    - Great for both kids and adults during celebrations or seasonal events.
    - A charming customization option for memorable occasions and gift ideas.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun and thoughtful gift for kids, students, teachers, friends, and family members.
    - Perfect for birthdays, back-to-school events, classroom parties, holiday celebrations, and personalized keepsakes.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves cute custom decorations and festive handheld accessories.
    - Great for photo props, party favors, school events, and themed celebrations.
    - A playful gift choice that combines personalization, function, and decorative charm 🎉

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Felt Handheld Flag

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-1 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
